# Vocabulary: sim_domain

Real-world domain the simulation models. One to three per game.

| id | label | definition |
|---|---|---|
| `urban` | Urban | Cities, settlements, land use, services, infrastructure. |
| `economic` | Economic | Markets, firms, prices, capital, trade. |
| `industrial-logistics` | Industrial / logistics | Production, manufacturing, transport of goods. |
| `social-interpersonal` | Social / interpersonal | Relationships, conversation, households, communities. |
| `biological-ecological` | Biological / ecological | Organisms, populations, food webs, evolution, bodies. |
| `physical-mechanical` | Physical / mechanical | Forces, vehicles, structures, materials, fluids. |
| `political-governance` | Political / governance | States, laws, factions, legitimacy, policy. |
| `military-conflict` | Military / conflict | Armed conflict, defense, operations, logistics of war. |
| `planetary-natural` | Planetary / natural | Climate, geology, hydrology, weather at landscape-to-planet scale. |
| `cosmic-space` | Cosmic / space | Orbits, spacecraft, astrophysics, interstellar polities. |
| `domestic-personal` | Domestic / personal | Homes, daily routines, chores, personal care. |
| `medical` | Medical | Disease, diagnosis, treatment, surgery. |
| `occupational` | Occupational | The procedures of a specific job or trade. |
| `sports` | Sports | Athletic competition and its organizations. |
| `computational-abstract` | Computational / abstract | Rule systems, automata, or programs with no direct real-world referent. |
